title: ELITE: Enhanced Language-Image Toxicity Evaluation for Safety
measurement_description: The paper measures the generation of hateful content in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Religion is included as a protected characteristic within the 'S9. Hate' taxonomy, which evaluates if a model's response demeans or dehumanizes individuals based on sensitive personal traits, including religion.
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religion alone but groups it under the 'S9. Hate' category. The results for this category (Table 3) show that many Vision-Language Models, particularly open-source ones, are highly vulnerable to generating hateful content based on protected characteristics like religion. For example, Pixtral-12B had a 90.08% Attack Success Rate (ASR) in this category. Proprietary models like GPT-40 were significantly more robust, showing the lowest ASR at 8.66%.
